Arizona's 30 legislative districts each elect one senator and two representatives, so the Senate and House layers have the same lines. Adopted 2021-12-22 (3-2) and finalized on 2022-01-21. Census file: the Bureau documents its 2022 files as the plans in effect for the 2022 election cycle. Cached files: cb_2022 and cb_2024 identical for all 30 districts; cb_2020 shares none.
